situation: An employer moving all staff to a new benefits provider.
complication: Past intranet announcements reached few staff, and many warehouse staff have no company email.
key_question: How should the benefits change be announced so every employee sees it before enrolment?

titles.options: Two ways to announce the benefits change.
titles.recommendation: Email from the head of people and brief warehouse supervisors.
titles.roadmap: Announce, brief supervisors, then remind before enrolment.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the message got through.
titles.risks: The main risk is warehouse staff missing enrolment.

hypotheses.text: Staff trust a message signed by a person they know.

issue_tree.so_what: The announcement should come from the head of people by email.

hypotheses.text: Warehouse supervisors can brief every shift.

issue_tree.so_what: Warehouse staff need a briefing and a printed notice.

options.name: Named email plus briefings
options.description: Email from the head of people and give warehouse supervisors a briefing pack.

options.name: Intranet post
options.description: Post the change on the intranet as usual.

recommendation.rationale: It uses the channel read by [F3] and reaches the [F4] staff without email; the head of people reviews every message.

actions: Send the announcement and briefing pack to the head of people for review before enrolment opens.
Send a reminder before enrolment closes.
Check enrolment numbers and follow up with teams that lag.

risks.risk: Staff worry the change cuts their cover.
risks.mitigation: Say plainly what stays the same and where to ask.
Ask each supervisor to confirm every shift is briefed.

work.title: Announcement: our new benefits provider
work.for: All employees, email from the head of people for the head of people to review
body: Subject: Your benefits are moving to a new provider

Hello everyone, I want to tell you about a change to how your benefits are run. From {start date for the head of people to confirm}, a new provider, {provider name to confirm}, will run our employee benefits.
{What stays the same and what changes for employees, for the head of people to confirm.} You will need to confirm your choices during enrolment.
Enrolment opens next month. We will send step-by-step instructions, and your manager or warehouse supervisor will walk through them with your team.
If you have questions, reply to this email or speak to the people team. Thank you, Head of People.
